## Import



TEO security client attester can be imported using the zoneId#clientAttesterId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Teo/securityClientAttester:SecurityClientAttester example zone-3fkff38fyw8s#attest-0000361666
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
